title: Book Two · Chapter 184: The Picture from the Visit
story:
During the winter holiday, Leo goes with his parents to visit the other city. Ronan sees him three days after he comes back. They meet at the river path with warm coats and cold hands.

Leo has two pictures. One shows the outside of a school. The other shows a small bedroom with a narrow bed and a desk by the window.

“Room for your bag?” Ronan asks.

“Under the bed.”

“Then you can sleep there.”

“I was thinking of the bed.”

Ronan looks at the school picture. There are students near the gate. None of them knows Leo yet.

“Did you like it?” he asks.

“Parts of it. The reading room is large. There is also a place for ball games after lessons.”

“And the people?”

“I met a teacher and two students. They seemed all right.”

Leo puts the pictures away before the wind can bend them. He tells Ronan about the journey. The train was crowded, the food was expensive, and his father fell asleep with the travel sheet across his knees.

“He missed our questions,” Leo says.

“A terrible mistake.”

“My mother saved the questions for dinner.”

They laugh, then walk quietly for a while.

“Do you want to go?” Ronan asks.

Leo keeps his eyes on the path. “I think I do. I also want some things here.”

“The group?”

“The group. My own room. This path. You.”

Ronan puts his hands deeper into his coat pockets. He looks at the river. Leo does not need to watch his face.

“The path will still be here,” he says.

“I hope you will too.”

“I have not packed.”

Leo smiles. They go as far as the next bridge, then turn back. Ronan tells him about the end of the boat story. Leo complains that he has not read it yet.

“I only told you the boat moves.”

“Now I know the biggest surprise.”

At the food stall, neither has enough money for a large snack. They buy a small packet of warm nuts and divide it carefully. Ronan gets one more because Leo drops one near the stall and cannot find it.

Before they separate, Leo talks about the living plan and the cost. His family still needs to settle those things. They have visited the school. They have not made the final decision.

Ronan gives the empty nut packet to the stall holder for the waste basket. Then he walks home. He can still taste salt on his lips. At the green door, he stops to warm his hands before he reaches for the latch.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

journey＝旅程；crowded＝拥挤的；settle＝确定、落实；latch＝门闩、门扣。

## 理解问题

1. Leo对外地学校有哪些真实期待，又舍不得什么？
2. 考察结束后，家里还有哪些安排没有确定？

## 读句子

**He looks at the river.**

拆开看：He / looks / at the river.

他／望向／河面。
